items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: the music contractor we use, Sandy... I’ll see her often at the show

ctx.x: Are you aware or not if the band that the singers bring are usually their touring people? Or are they sort of picked for the show?

It’s almost always touring. If someone has let’s say a bunch of horn players or they need a dozen strings then that will usually be a pick-up ensemble from the City. And you know, and in fact the music contractor we use, Sandy, who was the one playing violin in that thing, in that one story, I’ll see her often at the show with that kind of — you know a contractor bringing people in.
Just a personal aside I was happy to see a Hamilton alum from our college playing bass with Dua Lipa on Saturday Night Live. That was really cool. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
